The Prophet told Aisha that, but for her people being newly out of ignorance, he would rebuild the Ka'bah with an entrance and an exit door, which Ibn Az-Zubair did.
The Prophet entered the Ka'bah with Bilal, Usama and Uthman bin Talha, and Bilal told Ibn Umar he prayed between the two pillars.
Bilal told Ibn Umar the Prophet prayed inside the Ka'bah between the front pillars, about three cubits from the wall opposite the door, and Ibn Umar prayed there too.
The Prophet carried stones for the Ka'bah; Quraysh rebuilt it short of Abraham's foundations, which he would have restored but for his people's recent ignorance, and Ibn Az-Zubair later did.
An Ethiopian will demolish the Ka'bah, Hajj to it outlasts Gog and Magog, its cover and treasure, Umar kissing the Black Stone, and the Prophet praying or saying Takbir inside.
The Prophet tells Aisha her people built the Ka'ba short of Abraham's foundations, and he would rebuild it but that they had only recently left disbelief.
Carrying stones to rebuild the Ka'bah, the Prophet falls unconscious on removing his waist sheet; there was no wall around the Ka'bah until Umar built one, raised by Ibn Az-Zubair.
In the year of the Conquest the Prophet enters the Ka'bah with Usama, Bilal and Uthman bin Talha and prays between its two front pillars.
The Prophet tells Aisha the Ka'bah was not built on all Abraham's foundations, and he would rebuild it were her people not so recently out of heathenism.
Aisha learned the outer wall, left out for lack of money, is the Ka'bah's, and but for her people's recent ignorance the Prophet would include it and lower the gate.
